parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter to rows where efo_id IS NOT NULL and efo_term IS NOT NULL. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return DISTINCT rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id AS indication_curie, efo_term AS indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
